redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official pages, standards, policies, services or viewers retained as reference receipts; access does not imply current rows, bulk extraction or redistribution rights.
An exact artifact whose dataset-specific licence permits recorded public fields and derivatives, with edition, owner, coverage, schema, CRS, validity, attribution and digest pinned.
Registered, permissioned, request-delivered or otherwise restricted material used and redistributed only as specifically permitted.
Personal, subscriber, correspondence, unclear-license, terms-restricted, viewer-only or non-redistributable evidence may detect discrepancies but cannot become public output.

sources.provider: Universal Postal Union with Oman Post
sources.production_scope: The January 2026 country sheet defines three digits, post-office and region coding, and P.O. box presentation. It supplies no current code table, subscriber row or geometry.
A pinned office-locator record may validate its named office, displayed code and point at capture time. Completeness, history, service catchment and redistribution require separate proof.
Website terms are legal metadata. They restrict publishing website material and data mining or harvesting; a separately controlling product permission is required for reusable records.
The service establishes that Muscat Governorate issues building addressing or numbering. It does not publish reusable addresses, building identifiers, footprints or nationwide coverage.

sources.provider: Ministry of Interior / National Centre for Statistics and Information
sources.production_scope: The official service identifies a Ministry of Interior-owned wilayat polygon layer loaded through NCSI. Exact layer edition, owner permission, licence, coverage, fields, CRS and digest must be pinned before reuse.

sources.provider: National Centre for Statistics and Information
sources.production_scope: The policy requires open licensing for government data actually published as open data. It does not classify every portal layer as open or replace the exact dataset licence and owner terms.

sources.provider: National Survey and Geospatial Information Authority
sources.production_scope: NSGIA establishes national surveying authority, ONGD17 and geospatial standards. Governance pages and map indexes are not postal, address or building datasets.

sources.provider: National Survey and Geospatial Information Authority
sources.production_scope: Portal terms document registration and authorization boundaries. They supply no postal assignment, feature licence or automatic redistribution permission.

Catalogue labels the postal-office location workbook as Al Dakhiliyah coverage, 2024 publication, 4/2025 modification and 2024-2025 reference period. These labels do not establish the workbook current validity.

Twelve source-listed POIs, eight columns, no postal-code field. One duplicate XY pair, one whitespace-only Arabic name and two whitespace-only town labels; CRS and positional accuracy unstated. No rows or geometry bundled or activated.
sources.license_scope: Publisher open-data licence permits reuse and redistribution with attribution, modification disclosure and reserved third-party rights; not a licence for Oman Post, subscriber data or all Omani spatial layers.

sources.production_scope: Three-page open-data licence with source attribution, change disclosure, privacy and third-party-rights boundaries. PDF timestamps are not an effective date.

sources.provider: National Centre for Statistics and Information
sources.production_scope: The data.gov.om site links an Open Government License permitting reuse within its terms without separate individual permission. Do not extend the website scope to the separate geostat service or Oman Post.

sources.provider: National Centre for Statistics and Information
sources.production_scope: Four-page licence document; substantive pages 1-3 reviewed. Reuse with attribution, disclosed changes and exclusions; distinct bytes from the governorate document. Original licence retained instead of silent CC-BY relabelling.

artifact_partitions.contents: Pinned Oman Post office/code records, validity and lineage; no inferred catchment.
Permitted exact office points, separate from postal service areas and civic addresses.
Typed P.O. box addressing evidence without subscriber, recipient or correspondence data.
Optional versioned, uncertainty-bearing, non-canonical surfaces derived only from rights-cleared inputs.
Building/Way/Street evidence and exact rights-cleared building joins kept separate from P.O. boxes.
Separately licensed governorate and wilayat context with source CRS and edition.
Subscriber, recipient, contact, correspondence, account, resident, occupant, owner and query evidence excluded from public artifacts.
